raw_segments.text: Caesar, you take from me a great part of myself.
Sister, prove such a wife as my thoughts make thee, and as my farthest bond shall pass
Most noble Antony, let not the piece of virtue which is set betwixt us, as the cement of
our love to keep it builded, be the ram to batter the fortress of it.
For better might we have loved without this mean, if on both parts this be not cherished.
